legend.catalogue: In Kiro Crew's Connections catalogue (connect in the dashboard; some cards need an operator OAuth app or are hidden, then add the MCP endpoint by hand)
legend.custom-mcp: No catalogue entry. Works only if you add an MCP server or script yourself. Availability of a vendor MCP server is not verified here
legend.gap: No comparable Kiro Crew capability. The mate runs without it and says so

browser.label: Real browser (logged-in pages, JS sites)
browser.kiro_crew: browser tool / playwright-cli, off until installed in Settings -> Browser

scheduling.label: Recurring routines and reminders
scheduling.kiro_crew: kirocrew-cron cron_add; mate check-ins and heartbeat

subagents.label: Delegation to helper agents / other bots

dashboard-artifacts.label: Reports, pages, widgets, decks
dashboard-artifacts.kiro_crew: artifacts, widgets, deploy-web; pptx-maker skill for slides

shell-machine.label: Run commands on the user's computer
shell-machine.kiro_crew: execute_bash on the gateway host; computer-use needs enabling

github.label: GitHub
github.kiro_crew: Connections: GitHub (needs operator OAuth app) or gh CLI via shell

figma.label: Figma
figma.kiro_crew: Connections: Figma (card hidden, vendor allowlist; add endpoint by hand)

slack.label: Slack workspace read/post
slack.kiro_crew: Kiro Crew has a Slack chat channel, not a workspace read/post tool

google-sheets.label: Google Sheets
google-sheets.kiro_crew: CSV files through shell cover offline use

google-slides.label: Google Slides
google-slides.kiro_crew: pptx-maker skill covers local slide files

home-assistant.label: Home Assistant / Matter / vendor robot SDKs
home-assistant.kiro_crew: vendor SDKs can run through shell if installed

ad-accounts.label: Ad platform accounts (Apple Search Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads)

pstack.label: pstack (unclear, named only as an integration on the page)

x.label: X (Twitter): read timeline, profiles, posts
x.kiro_crew: no X tool. web_fetch reaches public pages only; posting is not possible

agentmail.label: AgentMail inboxes the bot owns
agentmail.kiro_crew: no mailbox the mate can send from or receive in

image-generation.label: Text-to-image generation
image-generation.kiro_crew: no image model. image-authoring skill draws SVG/Pillow/Excalidraw only

video-editing.label: Video editing, captions, clipping
video-editing.kiro_crew: shell + ffmpeg if installed on the host; no editor, no Remotion tool

remotion.label: Remotion motion graphics
remotion.kiro_crew: install Remotion locally and run it through shell; no connector

cloud-agents.label: Hosted cloud coding agents on a repo
cloud-agents.kiro_crew: spawn_run subagents work locally on a checkout; no hosted cloud agent service
